general.notes: Link lengths stated as 50 m POF (NA 0.5) and 70 m POF (NA 0.3). Power Dissipation in source is 150 mW typ / 200 mW max (Transceiver Electrical Characteristics). Supply voltage 3.3 V (2.97–3.63 V). Assert (PA) and Deassert (PD) input power levels note d states levels are also described as dB below unstressed receiver sensitivity for POF while table uses dBm. Rx sensitivity CSEN125 at 125 Mbaud; CSEN250 at 250 Mbaud; BER < 2.5 × 10^-10. Average launched power and many TX/RX specs at 1-mm POF NA=0.5, PRBS 2^7-1, 250 Mbaud where noted. Signaling: 4B/5B at 125 Mbaud (Fast Ethernet); general 10–250 Mbaud (8B/10B max per note d). No MSA pluggable form factor or LC/SC/MPO connector codes claimed.
